# Bundled service marks

Google One, Figma and Microsoft 365 multicolor marks are sourced from [Dashboard Icons](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons), distributed under the included Apache-2.0 license. Original marks and trademarks belong to their respective brand owners. The app uses them to identify subscriptions and does not imply endorsement.

For portable SVG rendering, Figma color classes are inlined into fill attributes and Google One has an explicit viewBox. Paths and brand colors are preserved. Source URLs and modifications are recorded in sources.json.

ChatGPT/OpenAI and iCloud paths are from the Simple Icons versions recorded in sources.json. The included Simple Icons license and disclaimer apply. OpenAI's mark is rendered in black on a neutral surface, beside the ChatGPT service name.
